facts.fact: OTR says individuals can create a NIF particulier online at nif.otr.tg or at tax offices, the platform also searching existing NIFs and issuing a registration sheet.
OTR says article 7 of the tax procedures book requires one unique NIF per taxpayer, and the individual NIF is required for customs clearance of personal goods and for property registration.

TGO.note: Online registration needs a national ID card or passport, but no check against the national ID register is stated.
